table.name: people
table.purpose: A small registry of individuals (mostly Russian volleyball players, judging by the names), each identified by People_ID and referenced one-to-one by the poker_player table, which holds poker career details for these people.

Birth_Date.name: Birth_Date
Birth_Date.description: The person's date of birth, stored as text in the format 'Month DD, YYYY' (e.g. 'April 17, 1987'). All values are from the 1980s.

Height.name: Height
Height.description: The person's height in centimeters (values 182–207, consistent with adult male athletes' heights in cm).

Name.name: Name
Name.description: The person's full name (first and last name), e.g. 'Aleksey Ostapenko'. All seven values are unique.

Nationality.name: Nationality
Nationality.description: The person's nationality as a country name; 6 of 7 rows are 'Russia', one is 'Bulgaria'.

People_ID.name: People_ID
People_ID.description: Primary key of the table; a unique integer identifier (1–7) for each person. Referenced one-to-one by poker_player.People_ID, linking each person to their poker player record.

table.name: poker_player
table.purpose: Poker career statistics for people listed in the people table; one row per poker player, linked to their person record via People_ID.

Best_Finish.name: Best_Finish
Best_Finish.description: Player's best finishing position in a tournament (1 = first place / winner, 2 = runner-up, 3 = third).

Earnings.name: Earnings
Earnings.description: Total tournament prize money earned by the player, in dollars (values range ~105k to ~596k).

Final_Table_Made.name: Final_Table_Made
Final_Table_Made.description: Number of final tables the player has reached (counts, 10–42).

Money_Rank.name: Money_Rank
Money_Rank.description: Player's ranking on the all-time money list (lower is better; 58–166).

People_ID.name: People_ID
People_ID.description: Foreign key to people.People_ID, identifying the person who is this poker player (one-to-one).

Poker_Player_ID.name: Poker_Player_ID
Poker_Player_ID.description: Primary key; unique identifier for each poker player row.
